title: Graduate Traffic / Transport Engineer
apply_instructions: Email resume with cover letter to hr@onemilegrid.com.au (the advert's application address).
rationale: Graduate Engineer level (<1 year experience) in a Melbourne traffic and transport consultancy, reporting to a Director; requires formal civil engineering qualifications, which Marc holds (BSCE 2019, Advanced Diploma 2026).
Overlap is road geometry, Austroads road guides and AS 1742.14 from coursework plus clear written reporting from site work; transport impact assessments and modelling would be new.
Mandatory full working rights and a current Australian driver's licence are both met (485 full work rights to December 2027, Australian licence).
caution: Discipline is traffic engineering and transport planning rather than civil design or site work; Marc has not used SIDRA or traffic modelling tools. The page is an evergreen careers page with no posted or closing date.
gaps: No SIDRA or traffic modelling experience
employer_line: onemilegrid prepares transport impact assessments and design advice for clients, Councils and the Department of Transport and Planning, and its graduates report directly to a Director.
